# R Notebook for generating gene detection values
# according to XeniumClean's expression/non-expression threholds

# Custom function
```{r}
export_gene_detection <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    cell_type_column,
    assay,
    genes,
    output_dir,
    filename_prefix
) {

  # Get raw counts and normalised expression
  counts <- GetAssayData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )

  expression <- GetAssayData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "data"
  )

  dir.create(
    output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  cell_types <- sort(
    unique(seurat_obj[[cell_type_column]][, 1])
  )

  for (cell_type in cell_types) {

    if (is.na(cell_type)) next

    message("Processing: ", cell_type)

    cells <- rownames(seurat_obj[[]])[
      seurat_obj[[cell_type_column]][, 1] == cell_type
    ]

    cells <- intersect(
      cells,
      colnames(counts)
    )

    panel_genes <- intersect(
      genes,
      rownames(counts)
    )

    if (length(cells) == 0 || length(panel_genes) == 0) {
      warning("Skipping ", cell_type)
      next
    }

    counts_sub <- counts[
      panel_genes,
      cells,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    expression_sub <- expression[
      panel_genes,
      cells,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    # Detection
    detected_cells <- Matrix::rowSums(
      counts_sub > 0
    )

    total_cells <- ncol(counts_sub)

    detection_frequency <-
      detected_cells / total_cells

    # Mean normalised expression
    average_expression <-
      Matrix::rowMeans(expression_sub)

    results <- data.frame(
      Cell_Type = cell_type,
      Gene = names(detected_cells),
      Detected_Cells = as.integer(detected_cells),
      Total_Cells = total_cells,
      Detection_Frequency =
        as.numeric(detection_frequency),
      Detection_Percent =
        as.numeric(detection_frequency * 100),
      Mean_Normalised_Expression =
        as.numeric(average_expression)
    )

    results$Category <- dplyr::case_when(
      results$Detection_Frequency >= 0.10 ~
        "Expressed",
      results$Detection_Frequency < 0.05 ~
        "Not Expressed",
      TRUE ~
        "Intermediate"
    )

    results <- results[
      order(-results$Detection_Frequency),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    safe_name <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
      "_",
      cell_type
    )

    write.csv(
      results,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(
          filename_prefix,
          safe_name,
          "_gene_detection.csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

# ScRNA-seq broad
```{r}
export_gene_detection(
  seurat_obj = reference,
  cell_type_column = "scRNAseq_broad_type",
  assay = "RNA",
  genes = shared_genes,
  output_dir =
    "results/Xenium_clean/Xen1_scRNAseq_gene_detection_broad_celltypes_avg_exp",
  filename_prefix = "Xen1_scRNA-seq_"
)
```

# Xenium broad celltype mapping
```{r}
xenium_clean$scRNAseq_broad_type <- dplyr::case_when(
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c("Pod") ~ "Pod",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c("MC", "JGC") ~ "Glomerular",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "PT_Immature","PTS1","PTS1S2","PTS2",
    "PTS2S3","PTS3","Prolif_PT","NewPT2_PEC"
  ) ~ "PT",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "TAL","Prolif_TAL","TAL_DCT"
  ) ~ "TAL",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c("DTL","ATL") ~ "Thin limb",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "DCT1","DCT2","CNT","Prolif_DT"
  ) ~ "DCT",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "PC_OMCD","PC_IMCD","IC_A","IC_B"
  ) ~ "Collecting duct",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "EC","Prolif_EC"
  ) ~ "Endothelium",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "Fib","Prolif_Fib"
  ) ~ "Stroma",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c(
    "Immune","Prolif_Immune"
  ) ~ "Immune",
  xenium_clean$predicted.id %in% c("Uro") ~ "Urothelium",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

```

```{r}
)

```
